== Summary ==
Identified: [[Chris Menzel]] (grey hair, glasses, white beard, black penguin shirt; same face as [[:File:2023 European Championship Team Wales 7.jpg]]) and [[Angelo Consoli]] (glasses, white graphic tee; same face as [[:File:Angelo Consoli 2013 Hall of Fame.jpg]]). Other bowlers in the distance are not named.

The 2023 Naboo Regionals ("Foil Fest") weekend in Liverpool, UK (2–4 June 2023), hosted by Team Wales.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 Regional Championships]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-05-31
* '''Identification:''' [[Chris Menzel]] (grey hair, glasses, white beard, black penguin shirt; same face as [[:File:2023 European Championship Team Wales 7.jpg]]) and [[Angelo Consoli]] (glasses, white graphic tee; same face as [[:File:Angelo Consoli 2013 Hall of Fame.jpg]]). Other bowlers in the distance are not named.
